evidenceTypes.description: Strict Zod-validated claim-level consultation with fixed freshness classes, reciprocal source maps, excerpt hashes, conflicts, unknowns and a non-mutating handoff receipt. Machine-checkable when invoked; not a provider-level automatic handoff gate.
The offline ship gate over the current working tree
TypeScript strict compilation with no errors
The Vitest suite scoped to app, components, lib and scripts
A rendered observation of the affected screen from a real browser
Deterministic DOM and layout measurement across widths and themes; not taste judgement
Signed billing webhook replay, forced paywall states, 402 envelope and idempotency checks
Generated references, vault integrity and provider mirror drift
Skill provenance, unverifiable pins and per-provider secret confinement

One fresh-context reviewer checked an R2+ diff (money, auth, prompts, AI-output guards, schema, migrations, Server Actions, and the security boundary: secret and push guards, hook wiring, permission rules, and what decides a review is owed) from the review packet; npm run review:check proves every cited file:line before recording it. Once per PR, checked at pre-push. The rest of the control plane owes self-review instead (doc 34 W4): a session must not sign off its own change to a guard that constrains it. The receipt proves the review ran on exactly this content, not that its findings were acted on
evidenceTypes.producer: reviewer subagent on npm run review:pack; the caller saves its answer and runs npm run review:check -- <review.md> --actor reviewer

evidenceTypes.description: The main session reviewed an agent control-plane diff (guards, hooks, the gate, CI, manifests) from the review packet, and npm run review:check proved every cited file:line and quote against the code before recording it. Once per PR; a fresh-context review also satisfies it
evidenceTypes.producer: npm run review:pack, then npm run review:check -- <review.md> --actor main-session
